room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "koh-lehk-tee-vee-TAY": a grandmother, a father carrying a toddler and a teenage girl stand together arm in arm: the local COMMUNITY, la collectivité: COLLECTIVITY
note: Cognate of English collectivity. Une collectivité is a community, a group of people living together (la vie en collectivité = communal living), and above all a local authority: une collectivité territoriale (or locale) is a commune, a département or a région, which runs local services. It is not a collection of objects: that is une collection.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "kohn-say-SYOHN": a man raises his palms and gives way, letting a woman plant her toy tree on the model: a CONCESSION
note: Cognate of English concession. Une concession is something you give up in a deal (faire des concessions = to compromise), and also a right granted by the state to use land or run a service (une concession d'autoroute), a burial plot in a cemetery, and a car dealership (un concessionnaire runs one). Sans concession means uncompromising.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "rew-RAHL": a girl kneels beside a toy farm with a red barn, haystacks and cows in green fields: RURAL
note: Cognate of English rural. Rural means of the countryside (une commune rurale; l'exode rural = the drift from the land; le monde rural). It is the same in the masculine and feminine; plural ruraux. Its opposite is urbain.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "ewr-BAN": a boy carries a model of tall gray tower blocks and busy little streets: URBAN
note: Cognate of English urban. Urbain means of the town or city (les transports urbains; le paysage urbain; un chauffage urbain = district heating). In formal French it also means urbane, polite and refined, though that sense is now rare. Fem. urbaine. Its opposite is rural.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "ee-zoh-LAY": a single tiny model house sits alone on a little island in a glass bowl of water: ISOLATED
note: Cognate of English isolated. Isolé means isolated or remote (un hameau isolé; se sentir isolé = to feel lonely) and also single or one-off (un cas isolé). Fem. isolée. For a building it also means insulated (une maison bien isolée). Its opposite is entouré or, for a place, central.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "ruh-noo-vuh-LAHBL": a white model wind turbine stands by a small solar panel catching the sun: RENEWABLE energy
note: Cognate of English renewable. Renouvelable means renewable (les énergies renouvelables = renewable energy) and also, of a contract or a permit, able to be renewed (un contrat d'un an renouvelable). Its opposite is non renouvelable. The verb is renouveler.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "ay-koh-loh-ZHEEK": a green bicycle on its kickstand with a basket of vegetables, the ECOLOGICAL way to get to the town hall
note: Cognate of English ecological. Écologique means ecological, about the environment (une catastrophe écologique), and very often eco-friendly or green (un produit écologique; un geste écologique). Un ou une écologiste is an environmentalist; in politics people say les Verts. Its opposite is polluant.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "mew-nee-see-PAHL": the town cleaner in his orange vest sweeps the floor with a green broom: a MUNICIPAL worker
note: Cognate of English municipal. Municipal means of the town or its council (le conseil municipal = the town council; la piscine municipale; les élections municipales). Fem. municipale; plural municipaux. La municipalité is the town council. Its opposite is privé or, for a wider area, national.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "proh-gray-SEEF": four potted trees in a row by the window, each taller than the last: PROGRESSIVE growth
note: Cognate of English progressive. Progressif mostly means gradual, step by step (une baisse progressive; des lunettes progressives = varifocals). In politics, progressiste is the usual word for progressive. Fem. progressive. Its opposite is brusque or soudain.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "sahn-TRAHL": a planner pushes a big red pin into the exact center of the round village model: CENTRAL
note: Cognate of English central. Central means central, in the middle or the most important (le quartier central; le rôle central; le chauffage central = central heating). La centrale is a power station (une centrale nucléaire). Plural centraux. Its opposite is périphérique or isolé.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "day-pahr-tuh-mahn-TAHL": a big wooden jigsaw map of France stands on an easel, each piece one département: DEPARTMENTAL
note: Cognate of English departmental. Départemental means of a French département, one of the 101 areas between the commune and the région (une route départementale = a secondary road; le conseil départemental). Fem. départementale. In a company or shop, de service or du rayon is the usual way to say departmental.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "ahk-say-SEEBL": a young man in a wheelchair rolls easily up the new gentle wooden ramp: ACCESSIBLE
note: Cognate of English accessible. Accessible means easy to reach or enter (un bâtiment accessible aux fauteuils roulants), easy to understand (un livre accessible), and also affordable (des prix accessibles). Its opposite is inaccessible. A person who is open and approachable is also accessible.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
hook: "ray-zee-DAHN": a man in slippers and a cardigan proudly holds up the model of his own house with his door keys: a RESIDENT
note: Cognate of English resident. Un résident, une résidente is a resident, someone who lives in a place, often a foreigner living in a country (les résidents étrangers) or someone living in a care home (une résidence). A local living in a town is more often un habitant. Une résidence secondaire is a second home.

room_name: Le service de l'urbanisme · The town planning office
Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "trahn-zahk-SYOHN": at the counter a woman hands over green banknotes and the clerk hands her a rolled deed: a TRANSACTION
note: Cognate of English transaction. Une transaction is a deal or a payment (une transaction bancaire; une transaction immobilière = a property sale). In law it is also a settlement, a compromise reached to end a dispute (trouver une transaction), and in old or formal French a concession. Its opposite in that sense is un procès (a lawsuit).

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "kah-pih-tah-LEEST": a businessman in a top hat and a striped suit stacks tall towers of gold coins on his desk: CAPITALIST
note: Cognate of English capitalist. Capitaliste means capitalist (l'économie capitaliste; un pays capitaliste). Un or une capitaliste is a capitalist, an owner of capital. Its opposite is socialiste or communiste. Le capital is capital; la capitale is a capital city.

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "fohn-SYAY": a farmer on an old telephone cheers: "YAY!" PHONE-SEE-YAY: his field is sold, and the land deed lies by his knee (foncier = land): PHONE-YAY
note: Foncier means about land and property: un terrain, un bien foncier (land, real estate), l'impôt foncier or la taxe foncière (property tax), un propriétaire foncier (a landowner). In a second sense it means basic or deep, part of someone's nature (une qualité foncière; il est foncièrement honnête = he is honest to the core). Its opposite in that sense is superficiel.

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "lew-krah-TEEF": a girl's tin cash box overflows with banknotes and coins from her lemonade stand: LUCRATIVE
note: Cognate of English lucrative. Lucratif means profitable, bringing in money (un métier lucratif; une affaire lucrative). Fem. lucrative. Une association à but non lucratif is a non-profit organization. Its opposite is déficitaire or peu rentable.

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "ehg-zor-bee-TAHN": a shocked man pays for one small teacup with a whole wheelbarrow heaped with banknotes: EXORBITANT
note: Cognate of English exorbitant. Exorbitant means far too high, outrageous (un prix exorbitant; des loyers exorbitants). Fem. exorbitante. It is used of prices, demands and privileges. Its opposite is raisonnable or modique (modest).

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "koo-TEUH": a black COOT bird wears a sparkling diamond necklace on a velvet cushion: KOO-TEUH, so costly
note: Coûteux means costly, expensive (un voyage coûteux; une erreur coûteuse = a costly mistake). Fem. coûteuse. It comes from coûter, to cost. In everyday speech cher is more common. Its opposite is bon marché or économique (cheap, economical).

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "ee-nehs-tee-MAHBL": a jeweled golden crown sits in a glass case beside the safe, worth more than any price: INESTIMABLE: INESTIMABLE, priceless
note: Cognate of English inestimable. Inestimable means priceless, too valuable to put a price on (un tableau d'une valeur inestimable), and of help or advice, invaluable (une aide inestimable). It is never negative. Its opposite is sans valeur (worthless).

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "ahn-ree-shee-SAHN": a grandfather shows a girl a tray of old coins and tells her their stories; she learns a lot: ENRICHING
note: Cognate of English enriching. Enrichissant means enriching, rewarding because you learn or grow (une expérience enrichissante; un échange enrichissant). It is the present participle of enrichir (to make rich), but it is about the mind, not money. Its opposite is ennuyeux or stérile.

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "gloh-BAHL": a woman spins a big globe on a wooden stand: GLOBAL
note: Cognate of English global. Global means worldwide (le réchauffement global), but very often it means total or overall, taken as a whole (le coût global; une vision globale; une somme globale). Its opposite in that sense is partiel or détaillé.

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "pleh-nuh-MAHN": a jolly round PLENTY-MAN fills a big glass jar with candies right up to the very brim: fully, PLEINEMENT
note: Pleinement means fully, completely (Je suis pleinement satisfait; vivre pleinement = to live life to the full). It comes from plein, full. It is formal; in speech people often say complètement or tout à fait. Its opposite is partiellement (partly) or à moitié (half).

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "ehk-STEHRN": a window cleaner on a ladder OUTSIDE the tall window squeegees the glass: he works on the EXTERNAL side
note: Cognate of English external. Externe means external, outside (un auditeur externe; à usage externe = for external use only, on medicine). Its opposite is interne. Un externe at school is a day pupil who goes home for lunch, and in a hospital a medical student.

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "strah-tay-ZHEEK": a man and a woman lean over a checkerboard, planning their next move: STRATEGIC
note: Cognate of English strategic. Stratégique means strategic, about long-term planning or military strategy (un plan stratégique; un point stratégique = a key position). It can also mean tactical, calculated (une retraite stratégique). Its opposite is improvisé or, for a place, secondaire.

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "kohn-sewl-tah-TEEF": an adviser whispers into the treasurer's ear; the treasurer listens but decides: CONSULTATIVE
note: Cognate of English consultative. Consultatif means advisory: it may give advice but cannot decide (un comité consultatif; avoir une voix consultative = to have a say but no vote). Fem. consultative. Its opposite is délibératif or décisionnel (with power to decide).

room_name: Le bureau du budget · The budget office
hook: "mahn-dah-TEHR": a young man signs the big ledger in his grandmother's name while she hands him her signed letter and pen: her MANDATARY: MANDATARY, proxy
note: Cognate of English mandatary. Un or une mandataire is a proxy or agent, someone authorized to act in another person's name (le mandataire d'un client; voter par mandataire). In business, un mandataire immobilier is an independent real estate agent, and un mandataire judiciaire is a court-appointed administrator. The person who gives the authority is le mandant.

Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "pray-kah-ree-TAY": a woman in a worn coat counts the last few coins in her open purse, her shopping bag nearly empty: PRECARITY
note: Cognate of English precarity. La précarité is insecurity, living without a stable job, home or income (la précarité de l'emploi; vivre dans la précarité). It also means fragility, of anything that may not last (la précarité de la paix). The adjective is précaire. Its opposite is la stabilité or la sécurité.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "ruh-vahn-dee-kah-SYOHN": a woman firmly points at her red toy VAN on the lost-and-found shelf and claims it back: ruh-VAHN-dee… her claim, her demand: VAN-DEMAND
note: Une revendication is a claim or a demand, something people insist is theirs by right (les revendications des salariés; une revendication territoriale). It also means claiming responsibility for an act (la revendication d'un attentat). The verb is revendiquer. Its opposite is la renonciation (giving up a claim).

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
change: added; say override ew-toh-PEA (no pee syllable)
hook: "ew-toh-PEA": a girl at an easel paints a perfect dream town of rainbows, gardens and smiling houses: UTOPIA
note: Cognate of English utopia. Une utopie is a utopia, an ideal society (L'Utopie of Thomas More), and very often an impossible dream (C'est une utopie = It will never happen). The adjective is utopique. Its opposite is le réalisme or, for a society, une dystopie.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "pay-tee-SYOHN": a woman holds out a clipboard with a long blank PETITION, and a man adds his signature
note: Cognate of English petition. Une pétition is a petition signed by many people (signer une pétition; lancer une pétition en ligne). In logic, une pétition de principe is begging the question, assuming what you want to prove. Its opposite, a counter-petition, is une contre-pétition.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "ray-an-sehr-SYOHN": a cook shakes hands with a young woman tying on her new apron: welcome back into the team, her REINSERTION: REINSERTION, back in
note: Cognate of English reinsertion. La réinsertion is reintegration, helping someone back into society or work after prison, illness or long unemployment (la réinsertion professionnelle; la réinsertion sociale). It can also mean putting a part back in. Its opposite is l'exclusion.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "koh-lehk-TEEF": three children carry one long table together, one at each end and one in the middle: a COLLECTIVE effort
note: Cognate of English collective. Collectif means collective, done or shared by a group (un effort collectif; un sport collectif = a team sport; les transports collectifs = public transport). Fem. collective. Un collectif is a group or collective. Its opposite is individuel.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "ew-mah-nee-TEHR": a volunteer in a blue vest stacks boxes of food and blankets for families in need: HUMANITARIAN aid
note: Cognate of English humanitarian. Humanitaire means humanitarian (l'aide humanitaire; une crise humanitaire; une organisation humanitaire). Un or une humanitaire is an aid worker, and l'humanitaire is aid work as a field (travailler dans l'humanitaire). Its opposite is inhumain.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "ay-vahn-tweh-luh-MAHN": a boy packs for every EVENTUALITY: a raincoat in one hand and swimming goggles in the other, because possibly it will rain, possibly they'll swim
note: False friend: NOT 'eventually'. Éventuellement means possibly, if need be (Je viendrai éventuellement = I may come; Vous pouvez éventuellement payer par carte = You can pay by card if you like). Eventually is finalement or à la longue. The adjective éventuel means possible (un éventuel retard), and une éventualité is a possibility. Its opposite is certainement.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "koh-mew-noh-TEHR": a cook ladles soup from the huge shared COMMUNAL pot into bowls for everyone: COMMUNITY, communal
note: Cognate of English communitarian. Communautaire means of a community (la vie communautaire; un jardin communautaire = a community garden) and, in politics, of the European Union (le droit communautaire). Le communautarisme is putting your own group first. Its opposite is individuel or, for the EU, national.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "doh-mehs-TEEK": a man irons a shirt on an ironing board, a DOMESTIC chore
note: Cognate of English domestic. Domestique means of the home (les tâches domestiques = household chores; un animal domestique = a pet; un accident domestique). It also means within a country (le marché domestique; un vol domestique is more often un vol intérieur). Un or une domestique is a servant. Its opposite is sauvage (for animals) or international.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "nah-TAHL": an old man hugs a painting of the little village where he was born: his NATIVE village: NATAL, native
note: Cognate of English natal. Natal means native, where you were born (mon village natal; sa langue natale = mother tongue, more often langue maternelle). Plural natals. It is not about birth itself, which is la naissance; prénatal and postnatal are about pregnancy. Its opposite is d'adoption (un pays d'adoption).

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "ruh-pray-zahn-tah-TEEF": a delegate stands at a small lectern to speak for all the volunteers: REPRESENTATIVE
note: Cognate of English representative. Représentatif means representative: typical of a group (un échantillon représentatif = a representative sample) or acting for others (la démocratie représentative). Fem. représentative. A representative person is un représentant. Its opposite is atypique or peu représentatif.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "soh-lee-DEHR": even on crutches, a boy carries a shopping bag for the soup kitchen: everyone stands together, SOLIDAIRE: SOLIDARY, standing together
note: Cognate of English solidary. Solidaire means showing solidarity, supporting each other (être solidaire de ses collègues; une économie solidaire). It also means bound together, dependent on each other (des pièces solidaires = linked parts). La solidarité is solidarity. Its opposite is égoïste or indifférent.

room_name: Le centre social · The community help center
hook: "mah-nee-fehs-TAHN": a marcher holds up a blank placard, and a big toy ANT rides on his shoulder: MANIFEST-ANT, a protester
note: Un manifestant, une manifestante is a protester, someone taking part in a demonstration (une manifestation, une manif). The verb is manifester, which also means to show (manifester sa joie). It does not mean a manifest or a passenger list. Its opposite is un contre-manifestant (counter-protester) or un spectateur.
